notes: One logical two-leg gold/silver annual-CADF residual-reversion package. Q02 must evaluate combined package PnL, costs, density, and correlation; neither leg is a standalone strategy.

The EA freezes a pre-year 252-observation log-gold-on-log-silver OLS model only when the locked one-lag CADF and fitted half-life gates pass, then fades fresh residual crossings. Aggregate RISK_FIXED is split by normalized entry weights 1.0 and abs(beta).
